climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: A state whose hot, humid summers challenge growers, and whose industry only grew past novelty status in the last twenty years. Vitis vinifera is 75 percent of production. Chardonnay, Cabernet Franc and Merlot are the most planted grapes, mostly in central and northern Virginia.
